ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: The 2022 FIFA World Cup will be held in the “pocket country” Qatar in West Asia (land area 11,400 square kilometers). Read the “Qatar regional location map” and the “2009 Qatar population structure chart”. <image1> What is the main reason for the formation of Qatar’s population structure?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the regional location map on the left shows that Qatar is located in West Asia, along the coast of the Persian Gulf, and its national territory is relatively small; the “2009 Qatar population structure chart” on the right divides the population into “native population” and “foreign population”, and the column block of the foreign population is obviously greater than that of the native population, and is mainly concentrated in the labor-age group of 20-50 years old. Then reason: Qatar is a very small Gulf country, and the number of native labor force is limited; the West Asian Gulf region is rich in mineral resources such as oil and natural gas, and resource exploitation and related industries require a large labor population, therefore attracting a large number of foreign workers to flow in, forming a population structure in which the proportion of foreign labor-age population is very high. Therefore, the main reason is exploitation of mineral resources.

method.method_draft: 先读右侧“2009年卡塔尔人口结构图”：图中分为“本国人口”和“外来人口”，外来人口柱块明显远多于本国人口，且集中在20—50岁劳动年龄段，说明卡塔尔人口结构异常的核心是大量外来劳动力流入。再读题干文字：卡塔尔是西亚面积很小的国家。结合地理知识，小国本国劳动力有限，而西亚海湾国家以石油、天然气等矿产资源开采为支柱产业，需要大量劳动力，因此吸引外籍劳工，形成这种人口结构。结论为：矿产资源开采。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：左侧区域位置图显示卡塔尔位于西亚、波斯湾沿岸，国土范围较小；右侧“2009年卡塔尔人口结构图”把人口分为“本国人口”和“外来人口”，外来人口柱块明显多于本国人口，且主要集中在20—50岁劳动年龄段。再推理：卡塔尔是面积很小的海湾国家，本国劳动力数量有限；西亚海湾地区石油、天然气等矿产资源丰富，资源开采和相关产业需要大量劳动人口，因此吸引大量外籍劳工流入，形成外来劳动年龄人口占比很高的人口结构。所以主要原因是矿产资源开采。
